info.title: Wowo External API
info.description:
# Wowo External Partner & Administrative API

Production integration surface for POS partners, accounting integrations, and administrative back-office operations.

---

### Core Integration Principles:
1. **Authentication Boundaries**:
   - **Partner & Merchant Routes** require `Authorization: Bearer <device-token>` acquired via `/auth/activate` or `/auth/rotate`.
   - **Administrative Routes** (`/admin/*`) require `Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>` with optional CIDR/IP allowlisting and token expiry. Merchant device tokens are strictly rejected on administrative routes with `401 TOKEN_INVALID`.
   - **Public Routes** (`/public/*`, `/health`, `/docs`, `/openapi.json`) are unauthenticated.
2. **Strict Account Tenancy**:
   - All merchant data operations are scoped under `/accounts/{accountId}`.
   - Accessing an account ID not owned by the authenticated device token returns `404 NOT_FOUND` (never `403`, preventing account enumeration).
3. **At-Least-Once Keyset Polling Guarantee**:
   - Keyset pagination over `(updatedAt, id)` ensures zero missed updates and stable cursor navigation across large datasets.
   - When `updatedSince` is provided (sync mode), results are ordered ascending `(updatedAt, id)`.
   - When `updatedSince` is omitted (browse mode), results are ordered descending `(updatedAt, id)`.
4. **Idempotency Contracts**:
   - **Sales**: Keyed by `referenceId`.
   - **Expenses & Invoices**: Keyed by `externalRef`.
   - Identical replayed payloads return `200 OK` with the original entity.
   - Conflicting duplicate references with differing payloads return `409 DUPLICATE_REFERENCE`.
5. **Safe Non-Fiscal Invoicing**:
   - Commercial invoices are non-fiscal commercial billing documents.
   - System enforces `vatRate = 0`, `vatAmount = 0`, and `total = subtotal - discount`. Attempts to inject VAT return `400 UNKNOWN_FIELD`.
   - PDFs generated include the mandatory non-fiscal commercial disclaimer.

DeviceBearerAuth.description: Device Bearer Token obtained via /auth/activate or /auth/rotate (32 random bytes, base64url). Required for all merchant routes under /accounts/{accountId}/*

AdminBearerAuth.description: Admin Bearer Token seeded via CLI or operator portal. Required for all routes under /admin/*

SalesSource.description: Channel or origin where the sale occurred

example: WARNING: Admin token "Superadmin Production" (id: admin-uuid) has no expiration date configured.

get.description: Unauthenticated health check returning service operational status and server time.
Verifies the complete middleware authentication, rate limiting, and entitlement pipeline for an account.

post.summary: Activate dormant device with one-time code
post.description: Activates a dormant device using a 10-character Crockford base32 code. Returns the raw bearer token once (never logged or retrievable).

200.description: Device activated and bearer token minted

401.description: Code invalid, already consumed, or expired

post.description: Rotates the active device token atomically. The previous token remains valid for EXTERNAL_ROTATE_GRACE_MINUTES (default 15m) before expiring.
Immediately and permanently revokes the calling device token. All subsequent requests with this token fail with 401 TOKEN_REVOKED.

get.description: Returns account profile, subscription validity, and platform status. Exemption: Accessible even if account is suspended or subscription has lapsed.
Retrieves merchant profile including business name, taxId, contact details, and subscription dates.

404.description: Account not found or tenant mismatch

patch.description: Allows merchant to update contact information, address, and business name. Read-only fields (id, merchantId, isActive, createdAt) are strictly rejected with 400 UNKNOWN_FIELD.

400.description: Attempt to patch read-only field or invalid format

get.description: Returns keyset-paginated customer records. Supports ?updatedSince for sync.

post.description: Creates a new customer or reactivates a previously soft-deleted customer matching the unique externalId.

delete.description: Sets isActive=false and writes a customer tombstone for sync.

get.description: Returns keyset-paginated sales. When ?updatedSince is present, results are sorted ascending (sync mode).

post.description: Ingests a sale. referenceId must NOT start with WX- (reserved for commercial invoices). Replaying identical payload returns 200 OK. Differing payload returns 409 DUPLICATE_REFERENCE.

400.description: Invalid reference prefix (^WX- is reserved) or schema violation

delete.description: Hard deletes a sale transaction and creates an external_tombstones row. Guard: Refuses with 409 SALE_LINKED_TO_INVOICE if linked to an invoice.

409.description: Sale is linked to an invoice and cannot be deleted

post.description: Records a business expense. Enforces isDeductible = false in the database. Injections of isDeductible or vatRate fail with 400 UNKNOWN_FIELD. receiptUrl is optional.

400.description: Validation error or tax field injection

delete.description: Hard deletes an expense and creates an external_tombstones entry.

post.description: Mints an atomic WX-YYYY-NNN commercial invoice. Rejects discount > subtotal with 400 INVALID_DISCOUNT (never clamps). Rejects vatRate attempts.

400.description: Discount exceeds subtotal or tax field injected

put.description: Replaces line items on a draft invoice. Guard: Once sent, paid, or cancelled, returns 409 INVOICE_NOT_EDITABLE.

409.description: Invoice is not in draft status

delete.description: Hard deletes a draft or cancelled invoice and writes a tombstone. Guard: Non-draft invoices return 409 INVOICE_NOT_DELETABLE.

post.description: Transitions invoice from draft to sent and timestamps sentAt. Calling send on an already-sent invoice is idempotent (returns 200 OK).
Cancels a sent or overdue invoice. Guard: Refused with 409 INVOICE_PAID if already marked paid.

post.summary: Mark invoice paid & link sale transaction
post.description: Transitions invoice to paid and atomically creates a linked sale transaction with referenceId equal to invoiceNumber, source=api, isTaxable=false.

400.description: paymentDate is in the future or earlier than issueDate

409.description: Invoice is still draft or already paid

get.description: Streams the rendered commercial invoice PDF buffer with security headers (X-Robots-Tag, Referrer-Policy: no-referrer). Returns 410 INVOICE_CANCELLED if cancelled.
Generates a 30-day unauthenticated public capability link. Calling again immediately rotates the share token and invalidates the previous link.
Returns deleted entity tombstones (sale, expense, invoice, customer) ordered by (createdAt, id) for reliable partner synchronization.

get.summary: Download invoice PDF via public capability link
get.description: Public endpoint allowing end-customers to download commercial invoices without authentication. Enforces per-IP and per-token rate limiting.

404.description: Capability link does not exist or has expired

get.description: Returns platforms with aggregate account counts and subscription health.

patch.description: Updates flatFeeNgn, subscriptionExpiresAt, or suspends/resumes platform. Platform suspension immediately blocks all merchant device requests across that platform.

get.description: Searchable, paginated directory of merchant accounts across platforms.

get.summary: Get merchant account details & live metrics
get.description: Returns merchant profile, connected devices, and live count totals of sales, invoices, and expenses.

patch.description: Administratively suspends or resumes a merchant account. A suspended account returns 403 ACCOUNT_INACTIVE on all data routes.

get.description: Lists all physical devices registered or dormant for a merchant account.

post.description: Emergency operator revocation of a merchant device. Bypasses any rotation grace period.
Mints a new 10-character Crockford base32 code (valid 7 days) and creates a dormant device record for merchant self-activation.

get.description: Queries administrative and device audit events with filtering by actor, action, resource, or date range.

get.summary: Get usage stats & admin credential audit
get.description: Returns live system aggregations across platforms, accounts, sales, and invoices. Audits admin token expiration and highlights long-lived or perpetual credentials.
